questions.question: Is your HbA1c (a blood test showing your average blood sugar over about 3 months) between 7% and 10%?
questions.original_text: HbA1c ≥7 and ≤10% (53-86 mmol/mol) at screening.

questions.question: Have you had type 2 diabetes for at least 180 days (about 6 months)?
questions.original_text: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus for ≥ 180 days prior to screening.

questions.question: Do you manage your diabetes with diet and exercise alone, or with metformin, an SGLT2 inhibitor, a sulfonylurea, and/or a DPP4 inhibitor that you have taken without change for at least 90 days?
questions.original_text: Either treated with diet and exercise alone or on stable (at least 90 days prior to screening) treatment with metformin, a sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor, sulfonylurea, and/or DPP4 inhibitor as monotherapy or combination therapy, per approved local label.

questions.question: Are you currently breastfeeding?
questions.original_text: Non-lactating and has a negative pregnancy test at screening and baseline

questions.question: Have you had gastric bypass, another weight loss surgery, or a similar stomach or intestine procedure?
questions.original_text: Participant has had gastric bypass or other bariatric surgery or endoscopic procedure or any metabolic procedures (e.g. duodenal resurfacing, intragastric balloon, etc.) except for the following:

questions.question: Has your body weight changed by more than 5% in the past 3 months?
questions.original_text: Participant has had a self-reported or medically recorded change in body weight \> 5% within 3 months of screening OR has recorded change in body weight \>3% between screening and randomization.

questions.question: Are you using insulin now, or have you used it in the past 3 months?
questions.original_text: Participant is currently using insulin or used insulin within 3 months before screening.

questions.question: Have you used any weight loss medicine (such as orlistat, topiramate, phentermine, naltrexone, or bupropion) in the past 3 months?
questions.original_text: Participant is currently using or used within 3 months before screening any weight reducing medication including pramlintide, sibutramine, orlistat, zonisamide, topiramate, phentermine, naltrexone, bupropion.

questions.question: Have you used a GLP-1 medicine (such as semaglutide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, or tirzepatide) in the past 6 months?
questions.original_text: Participant is currently using or used within 6 months before screening any medication that contains a GLP-1R agonist component or a GIPR modulator (either by prescription or as part of a clinical study)

questions.question: Do you drink more than 14 units of alcohol a week (if you are a man) or more than 7 units a week (if you are a woman)? One unit is half a pint of beer, one glass of wine, or one measure of spirits.
questions.original_text: Participant's current alcohol intake exceeds 14 units/week for men or 7 units/week for women (1 unit = half pint of beer, 1 glass of wine, 1 measure of spirits).

questions.question: Have you had a major mental health condition in the past 5 years, or ever attempted suicide?
questions.original_text: Participant has a history of major psychiatric disorders within 5 years or lifetime history of suicide attempt.

questions.question: Do you or a family member have a history of medullary thyroid cancer or multiple endocrine neoplasia (MEN) syndrome type 2?
questions.original_text: Participant with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or with multiple endocrine neoplasia (MEN) syndrome type 2.

questions.question: Are you 18 years of age or older?
questions.original_text: Female and male participants ≥18 years of age at time of consent

questions.original_text: HbA1c ≥7 and ≤10% (53-86 mmol/mol) at screening.

questions.original_text: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus for ≥ 180 days prior to screening.

questions.original_text: Participant is currently using insulin or used insulin within 3 months before screening.

questions.original_text: Participant's current alcohol intake exceeds 14 units/week for men or 7 units/week for women (1 unit = half pint of beer, 1 glass of wine, 1 measure of spirits).

questions.question: Have you used any illegal drugs in the past 3 months?
questions.original_text: Participant has a recent history of illicit substance use (< 3 months) or in the opinion of the Investigator suspicion of current illicit substance use.

questions.question: Do you have uncontrolled high blood pressure (top number 160 mmHg or higher, or bottom number 100 mmHg or higher)?
questions.original_text: Participant has uncontrolled hypertension at screening (SBP above or equal to 160 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure above or equal to 100 mmHg).

questions.question: Have you had a major psychiatric disorder in the past 5 years, or attempted suicide at any point in your life?
questions.original_text: Participant has a history of major psychiatric disorders within 5 years or lifetime history of suicide attempt.
